fixture_requirements: A plain-CAD survey drawing with several sections tiled in model space
Ground lines on dmx* layers, polylines with >= 2 vertices
Scale texts on zdmt* layers within table_depth below the ground line's bounding box: text like -0+012.5 is an offset tick, pure numbers are elevation ticks
Title texts on 1-Title* layers containing the section keyword, e.g. A2-K0+250 section
At least one section that calibrates, and one with fewer than 2 ticks (to verify the invalid branch)
assertions: Read-only: DBMOD unchanged after the run, no entity added to the drawing
section_count == valid_count + invalid_count
sections with too few ticks (offset or elevation < 2) have valid=false; report says 'insufficient pairs' and gives both tick counts
valid=false when the offset residual > offset_tolerance or the elevation residual > elev_tolerance
with offset_tolerance lowered to 0.001, previously valid sections become invalid (proves the tolerance is really in the decision chain)
calibration is least squares: repeated runs on the same section give bit-identical results
scale_x / scale_y are Kx/Ky x 1000 (matching 'H 1:x V 1:y' in report)
when the title does not match title_regex: line_name empty, stake null, stake_m 0, but the section still appears in sections
ground_points is the ground line vertex count, sorted by offset ascending, consecutive duplicates removed at 1 mm
offset_min/max and elev_min/max match the extremes of the ground point list
with include_ground_points=false (default) the item has no points key; with true, points length == ground_points
a NaN residual is output as null, not a NaN literal (sentinel handling in Sections.Num)
lines[] aggregates by line_name in ascending order; stake_from/to are the station extremes in the group
single-section survey lines have spacing_min/max null (no adjacent station to measure)
crest_elev_max == highest ground-line point among the group's sections
sections with empty line_name do not enter lines[] (sections[] only)
when ground_layer matches no polyline, throw instead of returning an empty result
when line_filter matches nothing, throw and report how many sections were read in total
an invalid line_filter regex throws and echoes the regex error
an invalid title_regex throws
offset_tolerance / elev_tolerance / table_depth / pair_tol_x <= 0 throws (Sections.Check)
empty ground_layer throws
layer names support * wildcards and are case-insensitive (dmx* matches DMX-01)
tick texts farther than pair_tol_x in X from any ground-line vertex do not take part in calibration
